title: webresource
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): ContentFileRef, ContentJsonFileRef, createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

canbedeleted.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be deleted.

content.description: Bytes of the web resource, in Base64 format.

content_binary.description: Bytes of the web resource, in Base64 format.

contentfileref.description: Reference to the content file on Azure.

contentjson.description: Json representation of the content of the resource.

contentjsonfileref.description: Reference to the Json content file on Azure.

createdon.description: Date and time when the web resource was created.

displayname.description: Display name of the web resource.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

isavailableformobileoffline.description: Information that specifies whether this web resource is available for mobile client in offline mode.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

isenabledformobileclient.description: Information that specifies whether this web resource is enabled for mobile client.

ishidden.description: Information that specifies whether this component should be hidden.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the web resource was last modified.

silverlightversion.description: Silverlight runtime version number required by a silverlight web resource.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

webresourceid.description: Unique identifier of the web resource.

webresourcetype.description: Drop-down list for selecting the type of the web resource.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the web resource.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the web resource.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the web resource.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the web resource.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the web resource.
